Sumailalim sa inquest proceedings nitong Sabado sa Manila City Hall ang isang indibidwal matapos manira ng traffic light na pagmamay-ari ng Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA).

Ayon sa ulat ng pulisya, isang concerned citizen ang nag-report sa Barangay 707, Zone 77, Malate, Manila hinggil sa isang lalaking nambato at sumira ng traffic signal light sa kanto ng Quirino Avenue at Adriatico St. noong Mayo 29.

Matapos ang mabilis na pagsisiyasat, naaresto ang suspek at dinala sa Roxas Boulevard Police Community Precinct (PCP). Agad ding inireport ang insidente sa MMDA Traffic Engineering Center, na siya namang nagsampa ng kaukulang reklamo.
 
Ang nasirang kagamitan ay nagkakahalaga ng ₱48,697.62. Dahil dito, nahaharap ang suspek sa kasong malicious mischief (damage to property).
Nagbabala naman si MMDA Atty. Don Artes sa publiko na ang paninira sa mga pampublikong pasilidad ay may kaukulang pananagutan sa batas.
 #mmda

data.text:
#icymi, Indians have overtaken the English as the largest immigrant group in Australia, according to an April 2026 report. 

India-born residents now make up 971,020 of Australia’s 8.8 million overseas-born population, overtaking England-born residents, who now number 970,950. The third-largest country of origin is China (732,000), followed by New Zealand (638,000). Australia’s total population is relatively small compared to its geographic size: 28.5 million, slightly below Nepal’s.

When you look at the past decade, the shift is more significant. The countries of birth (excluding Australia) that saw the largest increases in Australia’s population between 2015 and 2025 were India (+522,000), China (+223,000), the Philippines (+171,000), and Nepal (+163,000).

This demographic shift reflects longer-term changes in Australia’s migration system, which has prioritized skilled migration and international students, two streams that have drawn Indians and Nepalis to the country. England-born residents peaked in 2013, at just over 1 million.

While migration has historically helped Australia grow its economy, it is increasingly politically charged. Australia is now facing one of its most severe housing shortages — with rents and home prices surging — leading to anti-immigration groups gaining traction. “The proportion of overseas-born people in Australia is approaching the highest we have on record…32.4% in 1891,” the Australian Bureau of Statistics wrote.

Beyond online hate, in July 2025, vandals sprayed racist graffiti at the Shree Swaminarayan temple in Boronia. And in August 2025, tens of thousands took to the streets to protest Indian migrants in Australia. 

Some residents say protests have persisted. “A couple weeks ago, I walked past [a protest] in the city [saying] ‘Indians out,’” Seeta Kanna, an 18-year-old student, told The Juggernaut.
